data.other_hard: demonstrated financial need; CSS Profile required; active participation in NYU Academic Achievement Program and/or Proud to Be First (P2B1) communities; must be admitted to New York University; invite-only for BMCC students
data.evidence_sentence: The POISE Scholarship is a two-year, tuition-only scholarship that meets a student's demonstrated financial need to help fund their pursuit of a bachelor's degree at NYU.
data.notes: Social science/humanities major, minor/pre-health track, and AAP/P2B1 participation are listed as conditions to remain eligible, so they are recorded as hard conditions only in part; the field_of_study and other_hard fields reflect them. Deadlines are given without a year (March 1 transfer application, January 15 financial aid), so they are recorded as annual. No nationality or GPA requirement is stated. Applications are invite-only for BMCC students, and the page describes up to five awards. Page is a FAQ, so the exact application procedure is unclear.
